class.name: SteamAudioPhysicsSceneBridge
class.brief_description: Auto-registers static occlusion/reflection geometry from every [StaticBody3D]'s [CollisionShape3D] under this node.
class.description: At [code]_ready()[/code], this node walks its own subtree for [CollisionShape3D]s that belong to a [StaticBody3D] and registers geometry for each one, the same way an individual [SteamAudioGeometry] would - without needing to add one manually per shape. A [CollisionShape3D] that already has its own [SteamAudioGeometry] child is left alone, so you can still override the material or opt a specific shape out. Shapes belonging to bodies that move ([RigidBody3D], [CharacterBody3D], [Area3D], ...) are skipped; use [SteamAudioDynamicGeometry] for those instead. Adding shapes to the subtree after the game has started is not supported. If you move this node's transform (or any collected shape's transform) at runtime, call [code]recalculate()[/code].

method.name: recalculate
method.description: Re-scans the subtree and rebuilds the internal SteamAudio scene to reflect any changes in shapes or transforms.

members.member: Whether the auto-registered geometry is disabled.
The material applied to every shape this node auto-registers. Shapes with their own [SteamAudioGeometry] child use that node's material instead.
